protocol_metadata.about: AILayer is an EVM-compatible Bitcoin Layer 2 solution built on AI-driven modular architecture, using Bitcoin light nodes and PoS consensus via Taproot threshold contracts for decentralized cross-chain interaction. Users can stake AILayer tokens to become PoS nodes that synchronize Bitcoin and inscription cross-chain operations via Schnorr signatures and Tendermint consensus. The protocol includes an AI Protocol Controller — a set of smart contracts managing prover registrations, miner activities, subnet operations, and reward distribution — alongside subnet networks specializing in AI model types (NLP, CV). The native AIL token is used for staking, transactions, and accessing AI services on-chain.
